# Norbert Barna, Product VP

> Norbert Barna (Hungarian name order: Barna Norbert) is a Product VP with 17 years of experience in regulated, high-trust products. He leads AI products in regulated finance and offers AI integration and custom development for businesses in English and Hungarian. The case studies on this site are authored by Norbert and describe his role, methods, decisions, trade-offs and selected outcomes.

This file is a concise, citable guide to the canonical portfolio at https://www.barnanorbert.com/. It is not a search submission and does not guarantee AI citations.

## Who

- Name: Norbert Barna (also written Barna Norbert)
- Role: Product VP. He is a Vice President at BlackRock and leads a product that manages 15 trillion dollars across its full portfolio; his team owns its AI development and feature design.
- Experience: 17 years across enterprise security software, banking, enterprise EdTech and capital markets
- Languages: English and Hungarian
- Profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/barna-norbert/

## Professional experience

- Vice President, BlackRock, 2026–Present
- Creative Team Lead, Instructure, 2023–2025
- Senior Product Designer, Instructure, 2022–2023
- Product Lead, Raiffeisen Bank International, 2020–2022
- Staff Designer, Balabit / Balasys / One Identity, 2014–2020

## Case studies

- [Raiffeisen](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/raiffeisen): multi-country mobile banking redesign with a unified design system and safer everyday money journeys (Product Lead, 2020–2022)
- [Instructure](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/instructure): explainable, human-reviewable AI workflows for enterprise learning (2022–2025), on a product used daily by several million people
- [Bitpanda](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/bitpanda): crypto trading, deposit, KYC and portfolio redesign on one shared product system (2021–2022)
- [Benker](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/benker): regulated onboarding, KYC and transaction flows for a blockchain banking platform
- [SportsGambit](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/sportsgambit): prediction-market MVP with explainable AI recommendations and guided agent setup
- [Kineticare](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/kineticare): Hungarian digital health platform for physiotherapist-led hand rehabilitation; brand, content and a Next.js platform, designed and built by Norbert
- [OnRobot](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/onrobot): no-code tablet HMI so operators can configure collaborative robot tools without pendants

Instructure and SportsGambit are AI product work. Raiffeisen, Bitpanda, Benker, Kineticare and OnRobot are product design, leadership and build work, not AI integration projects.

## Services

- Human in the loop AI integration for regulated industries (English: https://www.barnanorbert.com/ai-integration; Hungarian: https://www.barnanorbert.com/hu/ai-tanacsadas-fejlesztes): fintech, banking, insurance, digital health and SaaS product teams in Hungary and the EU
- Human in the loop means a person reviews, edits or approves AI output where it matters, with the interface showing sources, confidence and recovery paths. EU AI Act readiness (human oversight, transparency, logging, documented evaluation) is treated as a product design requirement, not as legal advice or a compliance certification
- Three parts of one offer: discovery, AI collaboration and custom development
- Five working steps: map the work before the solution; define access and human control; test the experience before the build; build a pilot that fits your systems; measure, improve and hand over
- People review what matters; evaluation and error handling are designed in from the start
- Custom development covers the interface, connections to existing systems, permissions, review states and failure paths, and can include the web platform the feature needs
- Web development and product design (English: https://www.barnanorbert.com/web-development; Hungarian: https://www.barnanorbert.com/hu/webfejlesztes): custom web application development, MVP development, product design for SaaS and fintech, company websites, content management, online payment and member areas, with design and build by the same person; typical stack is Next.js with server-side rendering and a Payload content system; evidence is the Kineticare build
- No prices, service levels, partnerships or certifications are published. Every project is custom work; price depends on scope, integrations, content, languages and the level of review
- Working languages: Hungarian and English; meetings, documentation and handover are in these two languages, including for German and other European clients
- Way of working: quality over quantity, with clients who invest their own energy and want work that represents their brand and products rather than a template

## Expertise

- AI products in regulated finance and high-trust systems
- Fintech, banking, crypto and compliance-sensitive workflows
- Explainable, human-in-the-loop AI product patterns
- Product discovery, user research and usability testing
- Design systems, accessibility and scalable delivery
- Product leadership across design, engineering and business stakeholders
